name: corpus-lens
description: Search a dated corpus of Joseph Smith's revelations and accounts by meaning, and by doctrinal theme.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Joseph the Prophet research corpus: about 3,000 source documents, searchable by meaning rather than keywords. Results are passages in chronological order, each with its source document and verse or paragraph — a reading list, never a claim. Searching is read-only. You need a personal access token from the project administrator.

tools.name: corpus_search
tools.description: Passages nearest in meaning to any wording, in chronological order.

tools.name: theme_lens
tools.description: Passages most likely to carry a named doctrinal theme.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: The theme names the lens knows.

access_token.title: Access token
access_token.description: Your personal access token, sent to you by the project administrator. Treat it like a password.

server_url.description: Leave this as it is unless the administrator tells you otherwise.
